visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short salt-and-pepper hair sits in a black folding chair under a beige camping tarp outdoors. He wears a dark grey long-sleeved shirt and tactical black pants. In the background, a clear stream flows over rocks surrounded by green trees. He holds a fixed-blade knife in a decorative black sheath featuring topographic lines. (2) The shot cuts to a closer view of his hands as he demonstrates the knife's features. The knife has a tan G10 composite handle and a stonewashed blade finish. He points at the blade spine and handle details while talking directly to the camera. (3) The man removes a ferrocerium rod from its holder on the side of the sheath. He holds the knife's pommel and strikes the rod against a specialized notch, producing a bright shower of orange sparks toward the camera to show the fire-starting utility.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 熱賣2000把 高砂蛇直刀新版來了. [Subtitle]: 超級熱賣的 CAMPFIRE 高砂蛇直刀. [Subtitle]: 新版本上市的喔. [Subtitle]: 這是使用的是玉山等高線版本. [Subtitle]: 刀鞘呢 你看多漂亮. [Subtitle]: 刀身不變 刀鞘新的設計. (2) [Subtitle]: 那高砂蛇直刀 一樣採用的是台灣南部山刀刀型. [Subtitle]: 這邊刀背加高. [Subtitle]: 避免敲擊把刀柄敲壞. [Subtitle]: 刀柄是 G10 材質 大的護工. [Subtitle]: 刀尾呢 維持了打火設計. [Subtitle]: 這裡還有一個打火石. [Subtitle]: 有完整的腰掛配件. [Subtitle]: 可以直掛、可以橫掛. [Subtitle]: 然後呢，這裏一樣有打火石. [Subtitle]: 加上我們的刀尾打火設計.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly male voice speaks in Traditional Chinese with moderate pacing and clear articulation. The background features a light, upbeat acoustic guitar melody in a major key. Faint ambient sounds of a river flowing and natural wind provide a subtle floor. (2) A distinct mechanical click is heard as the man unsheathes the knife. The speech continues steadily while he details the technical specifications of the materials. The guitar BGM remains constant throughout this section, providing a rhythmic base. (3) Repeated harsh metallic scraping sounds occur as the man strikes a ferrocerium rod against the knife's pommel. These transients are loud and prominent, momentarily overlapping the vocal narration. The sequence ends with a final spoken sentence over the steady background music.
